    """
    Given an `args` sequence of expressions, return a new list of expression
    applying absorption and negative absorption.

    See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Absorption_law

    Absorption::

        A & (A | B) = A, A | (A & B) = A

    Negative absorption::

        A & (~A | B) = A & B, A | (~A & B) = A | B
    """
    # check if args is a sequence
    if not isinstance(args, Sequence):
        raise TypeError("Argument 'args' must be a sequence.")

    # list of expressions to return
    new_args = []

    # loop through each expression in args
    for expr in args:
        # if expr is a binary expression and its operator is AND or OR and one of its operands is the same as self
        if isinstance(expr, BinaryExpression) and expr.operator in ( "&", "|" ) and ( expr.left == self or expr.right == self ):
            # if the other operand is identical to self, add it to new_args
            if expr.left == self:
                new_args.append(expr.right)
            else:
                new_args.append(expr.left)
        # if expr is an unary expression and its operator is NOT and its operand is the same as self
        elif isinstance(expr, UnaryExpression) and expr.operator == "~" and expr.operand == self:
            # add a new UnaryExpression with the same operator and operand
            new_args.append(expr)
        # if expr is not an EOF expression, add it to new_args
        else:
            new_args.append(expr)

    return new_args

    """
    multipliers = {

    RDFS.subClassOf or SKOS.broader

    Parameters:

        roots (Optional[Set[Node]]): The nodes to start from. If None, all nodes
            in the graph are used.

    Returns:
        A set of nodes that are roots in the transitive closure of the given
        hierarchy.
    """
    if roots is None:
        roots = graph.subjects()

    # Find all nodes that have the given property
    nodes_to_process = set(graph.subjects(prop, None))

    # Find all nodes that do not have the given property
    non_nodes = set(roots) - nodes_to_process

    # Add all direct children of the nodes to process
    nodes_to_process = nodes_to_process.union(graph.subjects(None, prop, nodes_to_process))

    # Check if there are any nodes that are not parents of any other node
    for non_node in non_nodes:
        # Check if this node is a child of any other node
        if graph.triples((None, prop, rdflib.URIRef(non_node))):
            # This node is a child, so we can't add it to the root set
            continue
        roots.add(non_node)

    return roots
